page_title: RAY 1-1 RMA | Rayo Vallecano v Real Madrid 18/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
90+7' Alejandro Ruiz couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Miguel Crespo (Rayo Vallecano) and blew his whistle.
90+5' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
90+4' It's a nice effort by Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Stole Dimitrievski. Easy save.
90+3' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) duly receives a yellow card.
90+1' Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
89' Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
89' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) makes a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
87' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Luka Modric as he is replaced by Arda Guler (Real Madrid).
86' Rayo Vallecano take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
84' A clumsy foul by Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle.
82' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Real Madrid.
82' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
82' Here is a change. Alvaro Garcia is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano).
82' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
81' Substitution. Raul de Tomas makes way for Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano).
81' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

80' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a fine strike towards the right side of the goal, but Stole Dimitrievski denies him with a great save. The referee signals a corner kick to Real Madrid.
80' Miguel Crespo (Rayo Vallecano) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alejandro Ruiz saw the whole situation.
79' Real Madrid players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
77' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul.
77' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
75' Here comes a substitution. Lucas Vazquez is given a rest as he is replaced by Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid).
75' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
74' The current number of corner kicks is 3:8.
72' The linesman signals that Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
70' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) replacing Eduardo Camavinga.
70' A substitution has been made. Brahim Diaz is replaced by Rodrygo (Real Madrid).
69' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
68' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
68' The resulting corner from Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is cleared.
67' Miguel Crespo (Rayo Vallecano) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
65' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) commits a rough foul. Alejandro Ruiz stops the game and makes a call.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oscar Trejo leaves the pitch and Miguel Crespo (Rayo Vallecano) comes on.
64' Inigo Perez has decided to substitute Unai Lopez and he is replaced by Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano).
61' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
61' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
60' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
60' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
59' A pass into the box finds Joselu (Real Madrid) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Stole Dimitrievski denies him.
56' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is substituted due to injury. Inigo Perez gives a chance to Jorge de Frutos.
54' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
53' It looks like Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) saw red with that tackle. Alejandro Ruiz won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

52' The corner is floated into the centre of the box, but a placed header from Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
52' The referee awards a corner and Luka Modric (Real Madrid) goes over to take it.
51' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
49' The game is interrupted now, Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
48' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) unleashes a decent shot towards goal from long range, but his effort just misses the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
48' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
47' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Real Madrid, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+4' It must be a yellow card. It is. Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
45+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Alejandro Ruiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' One of the players from Rayo Vallecano times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
43' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

43' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Andriy Lunin pulls off a brilliant save.
40' Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) is caught offside!

40' Joselu (Real Madrid) is first to react to a whipped in corner and flashes a header in on goal from close range, but one of his teammates inadvertently blocks the ball and stops him scoring. No wonder he's upset!
40' There's an opportunity for Luka Modric (Real Madrid) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
39' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
38' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) is flagged for offside.
38' 35:65 – this is the current ball possession ratio.

36' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) gets to a rebound on the edge of the box and strikes, but he only hits the left post and wastes a promising chance! The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
35' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
33' A pass from Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is intercepted by Stole Dimitrievski and the move breaks down.
33' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
32' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

31' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Andriy Lunin shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
30' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) sends the corner into the box, but Andriy Lunin intercepts it and averts the threat.
30' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
27' 1 - 1 Goal! Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) sends the keeper to ground and scores into the roof of the net.
27' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
27' It’s a PENALTY to Rayo Vallecano after the VAR review!

25' Play continues despite the shouts by some Rayo Vallecano players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Alejandro Ruiz interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
24' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
21' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
20' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
19' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) whips in a cross from the corner, but Stole Dimitrievski is well positioned and punches the ball away.
18' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
17' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alejandro Ruiz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
16' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
13' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Luka Modric (Real Madrid).
12' The game is interrupted as Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is flagged offside.
11' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle. Joselu (Real Madrid) commits a foul after dangerous play.
11' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
9' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
8' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
8' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
6' A spell of possession for Real Madrid in an attempt to control the game.

3' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Alejandro Ruiz to decide. The relieved Real Madrid players can finally celebrate. Joselu (Real Madrid) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets inside the right post.
3' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Alejandro Ruiz wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
3' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Joselu (Real Madrid) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
3' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul.
2' Real Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
1' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Real Madrid will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Alejandro Ruiz.
